exposure.needed: whether ImageRepository (image.toolkit.fluxcd.io) objects exist in the cluster stored as v1beta2, i.e. whether the CRD's status.storedVersions still lists v1beta2

consequence.statement: Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten. A storage version migration and an update to status.storedVersions must be done before a later release removes v1beta2.
consequence.remediation: Rewrite all ImageRepository objects so they are stored as v1. Then remove v1beta2 from status.storedVersions on the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD.

assertion.statement: The storage version of the imagerepositories.image.toolkit.fluxcd.io CRD changes from v1beta2 to v1. Existing ImageRepository objects stay stored as v1beta2 until they are rewritten, so a storage version migration and an update to status.storedVersions are needed before a later release removes v1beta2.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for migration migration-required
